response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM grp), base AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM shares) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt AS distinct_transaction_count, share, share - baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM base WHERE share > baseline
